Special Branch,
May 22, 1937.

Proposed arrival and movements of Japanese
Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor.

Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor, accompanied
by Lieutenant-Commander G. Takase, adjutant, is expected to
arrive in Shanghai from Japan on board the s.s. "Nagasaki
Maru" during the afternoon of May 24, 1937.

After disembarking from the vessel at the N.Y.K. Wayside
Wharf, the admiral will proceed to the residence of Rear-
Admiral T. Honda, Naval Attache to the Japanese Embassy,
246 Darroch Road, where he will reside during his sojourn in
Shanghai.

On May 25 and 26 Admiral Takahashi will inspect the
Japanese Naval Landing Party, Kiangwan Road, its detachments,
and the war zone of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1932.

At 7.30 p.m. May 26, the admiral will deliver a lecture
to local members of the Japanese Navy League in the Japanese
Club, Boone Road.

On May 27, the admiral will proceed by motor car to
Soochow on a sight seeing trip. On the morning of May 28,
he will leave Shanghai for Hankow by aeroplane.

After carrying out an inspection tour of the upper
Yangtse ports the admiral is expected to return to Shanghai
on June 6 and leave for Japan aboard the s.s. "Shanghai Maru" on
June 7.

Lieutenant Fukumi, adjutant of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party, states that no Municipal Police escort for
Admiral Takahashi is required.

1937年5月22日。

日本最高战争参议官高桥（S. Takahashi）海军大将的拟议抵达及行踪。

日本最高战争参议官高桥（S. Takahashi）海军大将，由副官高濑（G. Takase）少佐陪同，预计将于1937年5月24日下午乘“长崎丸”号轮船从日本抵达上海。

在杨树浦日本邮船会社码头下船后，大将将前往达罗克路246号日本驻华大使馆海军武官本田（T. Honda）海军少将的寓所，他在上海逗留期间将居住于此。

5月25日和26日，高桥大将将检阅位于江湾路的日本海军陆战队及其分队，并视察1932年中日敌对行动的战區。

5月26日晚上7点30分，大将将在北四川路日本俱乐部向当地日本海军协会成员发表演讲。

5月27日，大将将乘汽车前往苏州观光。5月28日上午，他将乘飞机离开上海前往汉口。

在对长江上游港口进行视察后，大将预计将于6月6日返回上海，并于6月7日乘“上海丸”号轮船离开前往日本。

日本海军陆战队副官福富（Fukumi）中尉表示，高桥大将不需要公共租界工部局警务处的护卫。

Military Attache, 1147 Dixwell Road, (2) Japanese

128 Quinsan Road, (4) Japanese Naval Club, 400

REPORT
Date June 6, 1937.

Subject (in full) Departure of Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor,
for Japan.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J Boyce I S I

Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor, left
Shanghai for Japan on board the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" which
sailed from the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf at 9 a.m. June 6, 1937.

A number of leading members of the Japanese community
including Mr. S. Okamoto, Consul-General, Rear-Admirals D.
Ohkochi and T. Honda respectively commander of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party and naval attache, and Major-General
S. Kita, military attache, visited Admiral Takahashi on
board the vessel shortly before its departure.

D. S. Kamashita carried out observation duty at the
N.Y.K. Wharf between 8.30 a.m. and 9.10 a.m., during which
period no untoward incident occurred.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH - 7 JUNE 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

May 24, 1937.

-2-

NICHI-NICHI

WARSHIP "TATSUTA" COMING TO SHANGHAI

The "Tatsuta", Japanese man-of-war, will arrive at Shanghai at 8 a.m. to-day from the upper Yangtse and will leave for Tsingtao at 1 p.m. May 25.

ADMIRAL TAKAHASHI COMING TO SHANGHAI TO-DAY

Admiral Takahashi, member of the Supreme War Council of the Japanese Government, will arrive in Shanghai at 3 p.m. to-day on the s.s. Nagasaki Maru.

The following is the programme of Admiral Takahashi's visit to Shanghai:-

Callers on the Admiral will be received at the Naval Attache's residence where the Admiral will be staying.

At 9 a.m. May 25- Inspection of the Japanese Landing Party, visits to the Shanghai Shrine and the Soldiers' Monument, and to various officers. At 2 p.m., inspection of Shanghai battle area.

On May 26- visits to the Toyoda Cotton Mill, Suigets Club, Tungwen College, the Natural Science Research Institute. At noon - Attend a tiffin party to be given by the Consul-General. Sight-seeing in the afternoon. In the evening the Admiral will attend the annual meeting of the Japanese Navy Association

On May 27- Proceed to Soochow by motor car and return to Shanghai at 8 p.m.

At 7 p.m. May 28 he will fly to Hankow.

Admiral Takahashi issued the following statement to newspaper reporters:-

" I know nothing of China except Shanghai and Amoy. My inspection will have nothing to do with military affairs in China. I intend to proceed as far as Chungking on the Yangtsze River.

ADMIRAL ABE COMING TO SHANGHAI

A Domei telegram from Hankow dated May 23 reports that Admiral Abe, who has been visiting that city on an inspection tour, left for Shanghai at 9 a.m. on the s.s. Nanyang Maru.

《日日新闻》

“龙田”号军舰抵沪

日本军舰“龙田”号将于今日上午8时从长江上游抵达上海，并于5月25日下午1时启程前往青岛。

高桥海军大将今日抵沪

日本政府最高战争委员会成员高桥海军大将将于今日下午3时乘“长崎丸”号轮船抵达上海。

以下是高桥海军大将访问上海的日程安排：

拜访大将者将在其下榻的海军武官寓所受到接待。

5月25日上午9时——检阅日本海军陆战队，参拜上海神社和军人纪念碑，并拜访各位军官。下午2时，视察上海战区。

5月26日——参观丰田棉纺厂、水月俱乐部、同文书院、自然科学研究所。中午——出席总领事举办的午宴。下午观光。晚上，大将会出席日本海军协会年会。

5月27日——乘车前往苏州，并于晚上8时返回上海。

5月28日晚上7时，他将飞往汉口。

高桥海军大向记者发表如下声明：

“除了上海和厦门，我对中国一无所知。我的视察与中国军事事务无关。我打算沿长江上行至重庆。”

阿部海军大将抵沪

据5月23日从汉口发出的同盟社电报称，正在该市进行视察的阿部海军大将于上午9时乘“南洋丸”号轮船启程前往上海。

Special Branch,
May 22, 1937.

Proposed arrival and movements of Japanese
Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor.

Admiral S. Takahashi, Supreme War Councillor, accompanied
by Lieutenant-Commander G. Takase, adjutant, is expected to
arrive in Shanghai from Japan on board the s.s. "Nagasaki
Maru" during the afternoon of May 24, 1937.

After disembarking from the vessel at the N.Y.K. Wayside
Wharf, the admiral will proceed to the residence of Rear-
Admiral T. Honda, Naval Attache to the Japanese Embassy,
246 Darroch Road, where he will reside during his sojourn in
Shanghai.

On May 25 and 26 Admiral Takahashi will inspect the
Japanese Naval Landing Party, Kiangwan Road, its detachments,
and the war zone of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1932.

At 7.30 p.m. May 26, the admiral will deliver a lecture
to local members of the Japanese Navy League in the Japanese
Club, Boone Road.

On May 27, the admiral will proceed by motor car to
Soochow on a sight seeing trip. On the morning of May 28,
he will leave Shanghai for Hankow by aeroplane.

After carrying out an inspection tour of the upper
Yangtse ports the admiral is expected to return to Shanghai
on June 6 and leave for Japan aboard the s.s. "Shanghai Maru" on
June 7.

Lieutenant Fukumi, adjutant of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party, states that no Municipal Police escort for
Admiral Takahashi is required.

1937年5月22日。

日本最高战争委员会委员高桥S.海军大将拟议的抵达及行程。

日本最高战争委员会委员高桥S.海军大将，由副官高濑G.少佐陪同，预计将于1937年5月24日下午乘“长崎丸”号轮船从日本抵达上海。

在杨树浦码头（N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf）下船后，大将将前往达罗路246号日本大使馆海军武官本田T.海军少将的寓所，他在上海逗留期间将居住于此。

5月25日和26日，高桥大将会检阅位于江湾路的日本海军陆战队及其分队，以及1932年中日敌对行动的战區。

5月26日晚上7时30分，大将将在布恩路日本俱乐部向当地日本海军联盟成员发表演讲。

5月27日，大将将乘车前往苏州观光。5月28日上午，他将乘飞机离开上海前往汉口。

在对长江上游各港口进行视察后，预计大将将于6月6日返回上海，并于6月7日乘“上海丸”号轮船离开前往日本。

日本海军陆战队副官福海（Fukumi）中尉表示，无需公共租界警务处为高桥海军大将提供护卫。
